rules.note: Production exposes SELECT-only RLS for these targets; authenticated direct mutation is rejected.
Target is absent from the live Production schema; repository path is stale/non-live rather than an authorization bypass.
AST inventory interpreted a Supabase auth call as an RPC-like target; this is not a public database RPC mutation surface.
Org-admin table writes can persist role_ids without proving each role belongs to the invitation org; acceptance then writes those ids through a DEFINER function.
Invitation acceptance inserts user_roles without enforcing roles.org_id = invitation.org_id; database-level role/org integrity is missing.
Read-only preview is bound to possession of the hashed invitation token and exposes only invitation preview fields; no mutation authority is granted.
Legacy authenticated SECURITY DEFINER resolver accepts arbitrary user_id and does not join roles to the requested org.
Direct org-admin table DML can bypass audited last-admin/concurrency invariants of the supported Migration 175 RPC boundary.
Production mutation RLS requires org-admin/super-admin as appropriate; retain acceptance coverage for the privileged boundary.
Caller-bound read-only helper resolves active organization-admin status; it does not grant mutation authority by itself.
Authenticated same-org/self INSERT can forge rows in the trusted audit stream even though ordinary UPDATE/DELETE are blocked.
Chart-of-accounts CRUD is tenant-scoped rather than exact accounting.accounts create/update/delete authorization.
Authenticated SECURITY DEFINER fiscal-period mutations have no exact permission assertion.
Authenticated fiscal-period read resolves tenant membership but does not enforce the financial read authorization contract.
Journal numbering helper is authenticated/member reachable and must be reconciled with the canonical guarded journal mutation contract.
These DEFINER posting helpers delegate to rpc_create_journal_entry, whose exact create permission gap is tracked in #150.

Migration 178 canonical manual-journal RPCs enforce exact create/update/delete/post/reverse authorization; reverse is sensitive and requires an explicit grant for org admins. Event/work-center public adapters require create+post.
Referenced RPC is absent from Production; caller is stale/non-live.
Same-org financial data is readable through RPC/function paths without exact accounting/report read permission enforcement.
Reservation CRUD is tenant/membership scoped rather than exact stock/manufacturing authorization.
Physical-count sessions are directly writable by active same-org members without exact adjustment/count permissions.
Wrapper reaches SECURITY DEFINER v2 consumption path that mutates stock, consumption, WIP and reservations with membership-only authorization.
Wrapper reaches SECURITY DEFINER v2 manual stock movement path guarded only by org membership.
Direct stock-adjustment mutations remain membership/status scoped rather than exact adjustment permissions.

The #150 caller migration now uses the atomic stock-adjustment RPC, but its server authorization remains org-admin rather than exact inventory.adjustments permission and therefore stays tracked by #153.
Inventory stock/valuation data is directly callable under tenant/RLS semantics without exact inventory read permission enforcement.
SECURITY INVOKER validation helper inherits caller RLS and does not elevate database privileges; retain coverage against unsafe future conversion to DEFINER.
UoM master mutations are org-admin guarded, but #163 must define and enforce a first-class granular permission contract.
Read/calculation-only UoM functions validate organization membership and do not mutate privileged state.
Membership-only UoM helper exposes receivable purchase-order data without exact purchasing read authorization; include in purchasing closure.
Stage-cost CRUD is membership scoped despite first-class manufacturing.stage_costs permissions.
Manufacturing-order lifecycle DEFINER paths mutate operational/cost/stock state with membership-only authorization rather than exact manufacturing permissions.
SECURITY INVOKER function contains cache mutation against SELECT-only RLS tables; authenticated client execution is functionally fail-closed and should be reconciled.
SECURITY INVOKER update targets warehouse data whose Production policy is SELECT-only; direct authenticated mutation is rejected.
Manufacturing costing/efficiency/variance data is callable without exact manufacturing/report read permission enforcement.
Referenced variance RPC is absent from the live Production schema; repository caller is stale/non-live.
Canonical caller-bound permission helpers enforce exact key and role/org/active/expiry semantics.
Edge Function authenticates caller JWT, resolves caller org with user-scoped client, checks exact reports.ai_insights.use before quota/service-role work.
